rule: Pieces scattered on a background are fragments of one hidden assembly. Translate them (no rotation) so that their shared connector regions coincide exactly, with the whole bounding-box overlap matching. The output is the union, cropped to its bounding box. Duplicate connector pieces merge into their twins.
scope: Translate scattered fragments until shared connector rectangles agree, then crop the assembled union. Mix catalogue-based strips with procedural 2D trees whose fresh 3x3 connector motifs are connected by coloured bars. Three to six backbone nodes, zero to two extra branch edges, optional duplicate connector and transpose; exact canvas controls through 30.

known_limitations: Tree geometry uses orthogonal lattice edges and 3x3 connector nodes; arbitrary partial-connector intersections and cycles are not generated.

authored_scope: Random scenes: a latent horizontal strip of 3..6 three-row motifs from 13 templates with optional bars, 0..2 vertical branches (bar + end motif) on width-3 motifs, and an optional transpose. The strip is cut into 2..4 overlapping consecutive pieces; each branch is a piece containing its attachment motif; an optional isolated duplicate motif can be added. Input size is 10..30 per side, or user-fixed. Strips up to 24 long; lengths above 22 are a synthetic extension. Fixtures are rebuilt from explicit latent pieces. Not supported: arbitrary 2D assemblies like test 1's branches attached through non-3-wide motifs, branches off branches, more than one duplicate, and pieces whose connector overlap is not a full motif.
authored_constraints: Every piece is tight (coloured cells on all four bbox edges) and 8-connected
Piece bounding boxes in the input are separated by at least one background row or column, so pieces are never 8-adjacent
Every wrong translation of every piece has fewer than 2 coloured cells matching across all fully-agreeing overlaps (conservative uniqueness for any greedy order)
Grid area >= 2.2 x the padded piece area, so the background is the strict majority colour
Every assembly cell belongs to some piece, and consecutive strip pieces share a whole motif
num_branches and duplicate requests are honoured exactly or the scene is resampled; out-of-range controls raise ValueError

review_counterexample.before: Exhausted 1000 attempts; 875 failed the over-strict ambiguity guard and 125 failed construction.
review_counterexample.cause: Rejecting every partial overlap also rejects inferior partial matches of a repeated connector, although the intended full overlap wins.
review_counterexample.repair: Require true-overlap area and coloured count to dominate alternative matching placements for every subset of fragments, rather than forbidding all inferior partial overlaps.
